verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Browserbase serves an llms.txt at docs.browserbase.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with agent-directed content. Docs pages are also exposed as .md files, and the llms.txt indexes the OpenAPI spec, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. Browserbase Skills add agent-oriented guidance for coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Missing for 10: evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant, and independent community corroboration of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: The docs llms.txt lists it under an "## OpenAPI Specs" heading
Browserbase Skills teach AI coding agents (like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex) how to browse and interact with the web
